records.description_rewritten: Beethovenpark is a public landscape park at Neuenhöfer Allee in Cologne-Sülz. Planet Randy's broad cruising description is undated. Its three user reviews are from 2022–2023, and only the last August 2023 report refers to looking for cruising but says the area was empty at the time. No confirmed post-cutoff reports, visitor numbers or exact sex area were found.

records.description_rewritten: Volksgarten Cologne is a riverside? No—public park in the southern city around Eifelstraße and the Kahnweiher boating pond. Planet Randy presents it as a broad cruising area, without any dated customer reviews. It overlaps geographically with the earlier Rosengarten im Volksgarten (#712), but the latter is one inner rose-garden subarea. Keep both research records and compare exact bounds during deduplication. The broader park is used for boating, garden hospitality and events.

additional_source_evidence.note: Original Planet Randy, zero reviews; Kahnweiher and whole Volksgarten.
Earlier #712 names a particular rose-garden subsection.

records.access_information: Public recreational green space and leisure boating. Restaurants/event sections may have distinct hours and property rules; no authorised outdoor sex zone.

records.description_rewritten: Kiesgrubensee Gremberghoven is a gravel pit lake beside A559 and associated wooded paths at Köln-Gremberghoven. The identical locality and lake complex described at Alberti See (#707) suggest a likely alias or subarea overlap, but earlier forum contributors argued about which lake side was mapped. Planet Randy's only dated review (2 July 2025) rejects the description of it as a gay lake; no post-cutoff positive activity evidence exists. Access across rail lines or destroyed bridge cannot be recommended.

additional_source_evidence.note: Primary source with only July 2025 visitor comment disputing gay identity.
Earlier #707 includes A559 lakes, conflicting pin and March 2026 bridge removal.

older_dated_posts.note: Commenter denies that lake is a gay cruising area.

records.access_information: Unregulated gravel lake and A559/railway infrastructure; destroyed footbridge makes old directions obsolete. Do not cross railway or motorway, avoid private quarry/fenced land.
possible_duplicates_or_flags: Likely same named lake complex as candidate #707 Alberti See; investigate if distinct shore.
Only recent-ish 2025 comment before cutoff is negative.

records.description_rewritten: Planet Randy's 'Parking lot Lustheide' refers to A4 motorway service/rest parking near Refrath and Köln, with an opposite-side Refrath entry in gay-szene.net. Planet Randy has zero dated reviews, and incorrectly implies both directional car parks share the name Lustheide. Gay-szene user comments say both were closed in January 2026, while an April 27 report specifically identifies the Lustheide side toward Cologne as reopened. That supports a provisional operational improvement for Lustheide, not current cruising or reopening of Refrath.

additional_source_evidence.note: Original Planet Randy entry, zero user reviews.
Other source forum January 2026 closed both, April reports Lustheide reopened.

recent_access_signals.note: Independent traveller user claims side toward Cologne reopened; not independent official confirmation.
Earlier that year both stopped due works; superseded for Lustheide only.

records.access_information: A4 motorway parking reachable only from designated direction. Official opening not verified; never cross motorway, rail/fences or use unapproved woodland paths. No sex-venue permission.
possible_duplicates_or_flags: Separate Lustheide and Refrath motorway directions; #706 broader original listing.
Do not infer current crowds or continuing operation based solely on old user claims.
